snippet.title: Juegue Con Su Amstrad 03: Max - Amstrad CPC Gameplay
snippet.description:
This little game came in a standalone cassette as a free game with the third issue of the Spanish magazine "Juegue Con Su Amstrad", which roughly translates to "Play With Your Amstrad".

This time around, you pop bubbles and destroy gorillas while collecting fuel to keep the saucer going.

Developed by AGD (Angel GARCIA DELGADO)
Published for the magazine by Sygran
